title: KT Manager Lee Kang-chul: "Batters are in good rhythm... hope Daniel holds his own," "Just pitch like you did in the regular season"
text:

 🌐 한국어 · 日本語 · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · العربية · Français · বাংলা · Русский · Deutsch Kang Hye-kyung Reporter 입력 2026.11.03 19:40 The kt wiz are set to face the Samsung Lions in Game 1 of the 2026 Korean Series. kt manager Lee Kang-chul stated that there are no concerns regarding the hitters' form despite a layoff of about three weeks, and expressed his hope that starting pitcher Wes Benjamin will provide stability in the early innings.
 [KT Manager Lee Kang-chul answering questions](Photo: Provided by Yonhap News) Hopes for Benjamin's early pitching
 The kt wiz and Samsung Lions will play Game 1 of the best-of-seven Korean Series at 6:30 p.m. on the 3rd at Suwon kt wiz Park. kt, which advanced directly to the Korean Series after finishing first in the regular season, will start Wes Benjamin, while Samsung will send Choi Won-tae to the mound. In his pre-game press conference, kt manager Lee Kang-chul dismissed concerns that the lack of competitive games might affect performance. He mentioned that he watched the hitters during practice games and said, "I have been watching the hitters, and they are hitting very well. I don't have any concerns at all." Regarding the pitching staff, however, he emphasized the role of Benjamin. Manager Lee explained that he hopes Benjamin shows the same form he did during the regular season, adding that it is important for the starting pitcher to manage the early innings well.
 kt lineup led by offensive power
 kt plans to play the game relying on the strength of its lineup once Benjamin overcomes the early pressure. Benjamin pitched 55 innings in 10 appearances during the 2026 regular season, recording 5 wins, 2 losses, and a 2.13 ERA. kt's starting lineup for Game 1 features Choi Won-jun in right field, Kim Min-hyuk in left field, Ahn Hyun-min as designated hitter, Sam Hilliard in center field, and Kim Hyun-soo at first base. Kim Sang-su, Hur Kyoung-min, Han Seung-taek, and Jang Joon-won will play second base, third base, catcher, and shortstop, respectively. The decision to use Ahn Hyun-min as the designated hitter instead of Jang Sung-woo was made with defense in mind. Manager Lee explained that because Benjamin is a fly-ball pitcher and Samsung has many left-handed hitters, it was necessary to strengthen the outfield defense. Jang Sung-woo will be excluded from the starting lineup and will be waiting on the bench.
 A matchup of layoff vs. game sense
 Although kt advanced directly to the Korean Series after finishing first in the regular season, the team has not played an official game for about three weeks leading up to Game 1. Conversely, Samsung has maintained its game sense by advancing through the playoffs. Key points to watch in Game 1 include whether the kt lineup can maintain its hitting form after a long break and how Samsung's left-handed hitters will attack Benjamin's pitches. kt has constructed its lineup for the first game with both offensive power and outfield defense in mind.
 Increased responsibility through contract renewal
 Ahead of the Korean Series, manager Lee Kang-chul renewed his contract with the kt club for three years totaling 3.4 billion won. The deal, which includes a 10 billion won signing bonus and an annual salary of 800 million won, is the highest in team history. He said that while in the past he felt it was enough to have simply brought the team to this level, his mindset is different this time. He explained that his sense of responsibility has grown due to the team being highly regarded and his contract renewal, and that there is no turning back in the Korean Series. Manager Lee stated that he has always tried to approach big games with the same mindset as the regular season, both as a player and as a coach. At the same time, he emphasized the principle of trying to play the game in a positive and relaxed manner.
